contexts.text: The Scientific and Rational of the celestial man is described by the shrub, and herb ().
The shrub of the field, etc. = all in general which his external man produces.
The tranquillity which is of peace, produces what are called the shrub of the field, and the herb of the field, which, in special, = rational and scientific things from a celestial spiritual origin.
As a seed grows into a sapling, then into a great tree.
Shrubs () = nascent truths of a like kind. ( = Knowledges of truth. AE 410:6.)
Occurs. TCR 421:2. TCR 491:2. TCR 585. TCR 653:2. TCR 692:4. TCR 756:2. LJPost 217. LJPost 221.
The less perfect (plants) are wine trees and shrubs. (See Shrub, at AC 10770.)
Shrubs which turn their faces to the sun.
a. As it were a shrub glittering with crystals suspended from their ears.
